about.headline: Building visuals from the ground up through form, light, and tactile detail.
paragraphs: I am a communication designer drawn to how things look, move, and feel. My work moves between visual design, 3D, and motion, with a focus on form, atmosphere, and detail.

I enjoy building visuals from the ground up—shaping lighting, texture, and composition until they carry a clear mood. Whether crafting horological product studies or quiet atmospheric stills, I treat every frame as both an editorial composition and a sensory object.

experience.title: B.Des in Visual Communication
experience.description: Focusing on visual communication, motion graphics, 3D visualization, publication design, and brand systems.

experience.title: Independent Visual & 3D Designer
experience.description: Creating 3D product films, lookdev explorations, and visual identity assets with an emphasis on material realism and pacing.

contact.ctaHeading: Let's shape something with clarity and atmosphere.

projects.title: Tissot — Time, Refined
projects.subtitle: Horological 3D Lookdev & Specular Motion Study
projects.summary: A study in metallic precision, brushed steel micro-textures, and controlled studio reflections exploring the quiet mechanics of a classic chronograph.
projects.challenge: Watchmaking visuals rely on razor-sharp grazing highlights. The challenge was balancing dramatic chiaroscuro with dial legibility and anisotropic metal shaders.
projects.process: Built procedural brushed-steel and sapphire glass shaders. Choreographed slow, weighted camera dolly moves that let light travel across the bezel.
projects.outcome: A cohesive series of macro styleframes and motion sequences capturing the weight and craft of Swiss horology.

projects.title: Preet — Heritage in Motion
projects.subtitle: Cultural Typography, Warmth & Visual Narrative
projects.summary: Translating traditional Indian textile warmth, folk motifs, and expressive letterforms into a contemporary moving visual system.
projects.challenge: Preserving the tactile imperfection and emotional warmth of heritage craft when translating it into digital motion.
projects.process: Combined calligraphic curves with rich earthen palettes, grain textures, and rhythmic transitions inspired by classical cadence.
projects.outcome: An evocative visual identity and title study bridging archival Indian aesthetics with modern editorial clarity.

projects.title: Afterlight
projects.subtitle: Atmospheric Lighting, Volumetric Fog & Mood Studies
projects.summary: An exploration of dusk, residual light, and architectural solitude—studying how a single light source can anchor emotion in 3D space.
projects.challenge: Creating believable volumetric depth and filmic halation without over-lighting the digital geometry.
projects.process: Experimented with physical sky models, gobos, and subtle surface roughness variations to catch late-evening light.
projects.outcome: A series of still frames that read like cinema stills, emphasizing mood and negative space.

projects.title: Still / Moving
projects.subtitle: Rhythm, Pacing & Kinetic Form Explorations
projects.summary: Short-form kinetic studies investigating the tension between static sculptural equilibrium and sudden mechanical motion.
projects.challenge: Giving digital primitives a sense of physical mass, friction, and pendulum-like momentum.
projects.process: Focused on custom animation curves, micro-secondary motion, and tactile shader contrast between matte stone and metal.
projects.outcome: A curated collection of seamless loops and motion vignettes that anchor the portfolio's core philosophy.

projects.title: The In-Between
projects.subtitle: Liminal Spaces, Texture & Quiet Observation
projects.summary: Observational frames capturing transitional moments, quiet geometry, and natural light interplay in everyday environments.
projects.challenge: Finding narrative cohesion across disparate moments through strict compositional discipline.
projects.process: Curated and sequenced stills based on directional light, shadow geometry, and warm-to-cool color counterpoints.
projects.outcome: An intimate visual essay that informs my approach to virtual camera placement and lighting in 3D.

projects.title: Form & Feeling
projects.subtitle: Materiality, Surface Imperfection & Tactile Shaders
projects.summary: Exploring how subsurface scattering, micro-scratches, and organic silhouettes evoke a physical, touchable response on screen.
projects.challenge: Overcoming the sterile perfection of default computer graphics to make digital objects feel aged and handled.
projects.process: Layered procedural noise maps, fingerprint roughness breakups, and soft studio lighting to emphasize surface topography.
projects.outcome: A foundational lookdev library used across subsequent commercial and personal 3D projects.
